simple.meaning: קָהָה (qâhâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be dull.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Ecclesiastes, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, beginning at Ecclesiastes 10:10. Its contexts include land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָהָה (H6949).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קָהָה (qâhâh) / H6949 is traced through Ecclesiastes 10:10, Jeremiah 31:29, Jeremiah 31:30, Ezekiel 18:2 as a generated source-based concept entry.
